# Documents

This folder contains the raw, sequentially extracted text chunks from the Akut Kirurgi Databasen (AKDB) annual reports for 2023 and 2024. These documents preserve the original PDF content page-by-page, covering national and regional quality indicator results, clinical methodologies, supplementary statistical breakdowns by Charlson comorbidity scores, and regional feedback on data registration practices. They serve as the foundational source material from which all entities, topics, and comparisons in this wiki were derived.

## Pages

- [[akdb-2023-part-001]] — Title page, table of contents, and steering committee conclusions for the 2023 annual report.
- [[akdb-2023-part-002]] — Overview of all 2023 indicators and national results for Indikator 1 (antibiotics within 3 hours).
- [[akdb-2023-part-003]] — Detailed regional results and clinical discussion for Indikator 1 and Indikator 3 (CT scanning).
- [[akdb-2023-part-004]] — Department-level data for Indikator 3 and introduction to Indikator 4 (preoperative optimization).
- [[akdb-2023-part-005]] — Department-level data for Indikator 4 and introduction to Indikator 5 (operation within 6 hours).
- [[akdb-2023-part-006]] — Supplementary indicators 5x and 5y breaking down operation times for perforation, ischemia, and bleeding.
- [[akdb-2023-part-007]] — Results and clinical rationale for Indikator 6 (intermediær admission for high-risk patients).
- [[akdb-2023-part-008]] — Department-level data and ERAS-based discussion for Indikator 7 (early mobilization).
- [[akdb-2023-part-009]] — Results and registration challenges for Indikator 8 (nutrition within 48 hours).
- [[akdb-2023-part-010]] — Data for Indikator 9 (epidural anesthesia) and introduction to Indikator 10 (30-day mortality).
- [[akdb-2023-part-011]] — Department-level mortality data for Indikator 10 and introduction to Indikator 11 (90-day mortality).
- [[akdb-2023-part-012]] — Results for Indikator 11, database methodology updates, and supplementary cancer distribution tables.
- [[akdb-2023-part-013]] — Supplementary 30-day mortality analysis for patients with a Charlson Score of 0.
- [[akdb-2023-part-014]] — Supplementary 30-day mortality analysis for patients with a Charlson Score of 1 or 2.
- [[akdb-2023-part-015]] — Supplementary 30-day mortality analysis for patients with a Charlson Score ≥ 3 and gender distribution tables.
- [[akdb-2023-part-016]] — Supplementary statistical tables detailing the age distribution of operated patients across regions.
- [[akdb-2023-part-017]] — ASA score distributions, boxplots, and the methodology section detailing data sources and inclusion criteria.
- [[akdb-2023-part-018]] — Guide for local data validation, a plain-language summary of the report, and scientific publications.
- [[akdb-2023-part-019]] — Continued list of scientific papers, steering committee members, and 2023 regional comments.
- [[akdb-2024-part-001]] — Title page, table of contents, and steering committee conclusions for the 2024 annual report.
- [[akdb-2024-part-002]] — Overview of all 2024 indicators and national results for Indikator 1 (antibiotics).
- [[akdb-2024-part-003]] — Exclusion criteria, forest plots, and clinical discussion for Indikator 1 and Indikator 2 (CT scanning).
- [[akdb-2024-part-004]] — Trend graphs and department-level analysis for Indikator 2 and Indikator 3 (preoperative optimization).
- [[akdb-2024-part-005]] — Clinical rationale for Indikator 3 and introduction to Indikator 4x (operation within 6 hours for acute conditions).
- [[akdb-2024-part-006]] — Results for Indikator 4x and introduction to Indikator 4y (operation within 24 hours for ileus).
- [[akdb-2024-part-007]] — Discussion of ileus treatment variations and detailed results for Indikator 5 (intermediær admission).
- [[akdb-2024-part-008]] — Clinical rationale for intermediær admission and department-level data for Indikator 6 (early mobilization).
- [[akdb-2024-part-009]] — ERAS-based discussion for mobilization and results for Indikator 7 (nutrition screening).
- [[akdb-2024-part-010]] — Discussion on nutrition coding and department-level data for Indikator 8 (epidural anesthesia).
- [[akdb-2024-part-011]] — Analysis of open vs. laparoscopic epidural practices and results for Indikator 9 (30-day mortality).
- [[akdb-2024-part-012]] — Mortality trends, database methodology updates, and supplementary analysis of operated vs. non-operated patients.
- [[akdb-2024-part-013]] — Supplementary 30-day mortality analysis for 2024 patients with a Charlson Score of 0.
- [[akdb-2024-part-014]] — Supplementary 30-day mortality analysis for 2024 patients with a Charlson Score of 1 or 2.
- [[akdb-2024-part-015]] — Supplementary 30-day mortality analysis for 2024 patients with a Charlson Score ≥ 3 and gender distributions.
- [[akdb-2024-part-016]] — Supplementary statistical tables detailing the 2024 age distribution of operated patients across regions.
- [[akdb-2024-part-017]] — ASA score distributions, boxplots, and supplementary analysis of open vs. minimally invasive surgery rates.
- [[akdb-2024-part-018]] — Trend graphs for surgical approaches and supplementary time-to-operation tables for Indikator 4x.
- [[akdb-2024-part-019]] — Methodology descriptions, LPR inclusion/exclusion criteria, and guides for local data validation.
- [[akdb-2024-part-020]] — Plain-language summary of the 2024 indicators and the overview of scientific publications.
- [[akdb-2024-part-021]] — Continued list of scientific papers, 2024 steering committee members, and start of regional comments.
- [[akdb-2024-part-022]] — Detailed regional feedback from Region Nordjylland regarding indicator definitions and data discrepancies.
